serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Kernos is a multi-tenant, cloud-native “SaaS” (software-as-a-service) cloud service offering (CSO). It leverages Amazon Web Services (AWS), IaaS (infrastructure-as-a-service), and PaaS (platform-as-a-service) for its underlying infrastructure and hardware.

Kernos integrates near-real-time video exploitation, common operating picture (COP), advanced multimedia and full motion video (FMV) (unclassified videos), ultimate web-based communication, collaboration, and information sharing tools, advanced file management, targeting databases, fast & reliable LLM-based translation micro-service, state-of-the-art facial recognition, and object detection with built-in artificial intelligence (AI)/machine learning (ML)-based alerts,  and notifications capabilities into a cost-effective solution.

This combination of real-time data and advanced modern technology gives government and commercial customers a bird’s-eye view of operations, enabling decision-makers to plan and manage operations strategically.
